PART I GENERAL PROVISIONS
CHAPTER 1 PRELIMINARY

Section 101 Short title
This Act may be cited as the Data Handling Act.

Section 102 Definitions
In this Act, "personal data" means information relating to an identified person.

CHAPTER 2 DUTIES

Section 201 Duty of care
(a) A controller shall keep personal data secure.
(b) A controller shall not retain personal data for more than 5 years.
(1) This subsection does not apply to archives.

PART II ENFORCEMENT
CHAPTER 1 PENALTIES

Section 301 Penalty
A person who breaches Section 201(b) is liable to a fine not exceeding $10,000.
